stories.title: Fever's White rips critics: I stand by my players
stories.summary: Fever coach Stephanie White spoke out against what she called "an online community that's trying to create narratives" after some alleged she didn't defend Sophie Cunningham after she was flagrantly fouled by the Sky's DiJonai Carrington last week.

stories.title: Bears' Bryant has knee surgery, out 4-6 months
stories.summary: Bears safety Coby Bryant underwent knee surgery and is expected to miss four to six months, coach Ben Johnson announced Tuesday.

stories.title: Vikings name Murray starting QB over McCarthy
stories.summary: The Vikings have named Kyler Murray the team's starting quarterback over J.J. McCarthy.

stories.title: Tulsa will not play for LLBWS berth, judge rules
stories.summary: A Texas judge backed a decision to remove a Tulsa, Oklahoma, team from the Southwest Region and keep it from playing in Tuesday's title game for a spot in the Little League Baseball World Series, according to a statement from a Little League spokesperson.

stories.title: Maddux fired as Angels jettison pitching coaches
stories.summary: The Angels, who have a staff ERA of 4.51 and an MLB-worst 508 walks, have fired pitching coach Mike Maddux, assistant Darryl Scott and bullpen coach Dom Chiti.
